acceptance_rule.candidate: B_corr + minimum separation, 37654 px, min separation 3 px

B_only + separation (surface lineaments with no corroboration)
B_corr with its places rolled by a random tile offset (same mass, same geometry, no same-place pairing)
required: strictly greater fold-mean DTI than every comparator on BOTH instruments
>= 3 of 4 fold wins against the strongest comparator
identical comparator ordering on both instruments
format gate ok and uniqueness gate ok on the written bytes
